preconditions.expression: isinstance(s, str) and len(s) > 0 and len(s) <= 10**6 and all(c.islower() for c in s)
preconditions.description: Input string s is a non-empty string of lowercase English letters with length ≤ 10^6.
Integer n is the number of queries, where 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(xi, str) and len(xi) > 0 and all(c.islower() for c in xi) for xi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query string xi is a non-empty string of lowercase English letters, and the total length of all xi is ≤ 10^6.

postconditions.expression: len(output) == n and all(isinstance(count, int) and count >= 0 for count in output)
postconditions.description: Output is a list of n non-negative integers, one for each query xi.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < n and output[i] == count_cyclical_isomorphic_substrings(s, queries[i]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each query xi, output[i] is the count of consecutive substrings of s that are cyclical isomorphic to xi.
